title: New Flowering Plants for Gardeners to Try
titleZh: 园丁可以尝试的新开花植物
credits: The Associated Press gardening expert Jessica Damiano wrote this report. Caty Weaver adapted it for VOA Learning English. ____________________________________________________

sentences.en: If you are a gardener, you probably have some favorite plants that you grow year after year.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一位园艺爱好者，你大概会有一些年复一年钟爱的植物。

sentences.en: But you might also like to try new plants sometimes.
sentences.zh: 不过，有时你也可能想尝试一些新的植物。

sentences.en: Gardening expert Jessica Damiano recently reported for the Associated Press about one way to find new plants that might appeal to growers.
sentences.zh: 园艺专家杰西卡·达米亚诺近日为美联社报道了一种寻找可能受种植者欢迎的新植物的方法。

sentences.en: Each year, the independent, nonprofit organization All-America Selections (AAS) enlists more than 80 horticultural professionals from around the United States and Canada to serve as plant-trial judges.
sentences.zh: 每年，这家独立、非营利组织全美精选（AAS）都会招募来自美国和加拿大的80多位园艺专业人士担任植物试验评审。

sentences.en: Today, we share newly developed flowering plants meant to improve the appearance of your garden.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们分享一些新培育的开花植物，它们有望提升你花园的外观。

sentences.en: Celosia Flamma Pink is an upright flowering plant.
sentences.zh: 凤仙花'Flamma Pink'是一种直立的开花植物。

sentences.en: This pink variety is the latest introduction in the Flamma Celosia series.
sentences.zh: 这个粉色品种是Flamma凤仙花系列中最新推出的品种。

sentences.en: It is a small, easy-to-grow celosia noted for strong blooming and vibrant, long-lasting flowers.
sentences.zh: 它是一种小巧、易养护的凤仙花，以繁茂的开花和鲜艳持久的花朵著称。

sentences.en: Judges praised its good performance even in hot and humid weather.
sentences.zh: 评审盛赞它在炎热潮湿的天气中依然表现良好。

sentences.en: It also lasts a long time in a container after it is cut.
sentences.zh: 它被剪下后装在容器里也能长时间保持新鲜。

sentences.en: The plant is bred by Clover Seed Company.
sentences.zh: 这种植物由Clover Seed公司培育。

sentences.en: Vinca Sphere Polkadot is a flat wide-petaled flower.
sentences.zh: 长春花'Vinca Sphere Polkadot'是一种扁平、宽瓣的花。

sentences.en: Judges called this vinca variety resilient and beautiful.
sentences.zh: 评审称这种长春花品种坚韧而美丽。

sentences.en: With a naturally tightly grouped, rounded appearance, the plant blooms throughout the summer.
sentences.zh: 它天生呈紧密团聚的球形外观，整个夏季都会开花。

sentences.en: It grows well in hot, dry conditions and has good disease resistance and durability against heavy rain and storms.
sentences.zh: 它在炎热干燥的条件下生长良好，具有良好的抗病性，并能抵御大雨和风暴的冲击。

sentences.en: It is bred by Miyoshi & Co.
sentences.zh: 这种植物由Miyoshi & Co.培育。

sentences.en: Zinnia Crestar Mix combines “the best” crested zinnias in one seed pack.
sentences.zh: 百日草'Crestar Mix'将'最佳'的鸡冠草品种合并在一个种子包装中。

sentences.en: The pink, orange, red, white, peach and yellow flower blends well for mass plantings and succession sowing.
sentences.zh: 粉色、橙色、红色、白色、桃色和黄色的花朵搭配和谐，适合大规模种植和分批播种。

sentences.en: Succession sowing means growing several plants that bloom in different seasons in your garden.
sentences.zh: 分批播种指的是在花园里种植在不同季节开花的多种植物。

sentences.en: Zinnia Crestar Mix can also provide a continuous supply of cut flowers during summer.
sentences.zh: 百日草'Crestar Mix'还能在整个夏季持续提供切花。

sentences.en: The sun-loving plants also tolerated heat and humidity well in the trials.
sentences.zh: 喜阳植物在试验中也很好地耐热和耐湿。

sentences.en: It is bred by Takii Europe.
sentences.zh: 它由Takii Europe培育。

sentences.en: Dahlia Black Forest Ruby has ruby-red flowers that show up nicely against dark-colored leaves.
sentences.zh: 黑森林红宝石大丽花拥有红宝石般的花朵，在深色叶子的衬托下显得格外美丽。

sentences.en: The disease-resistant plant impressed judges with its overall durability.
sentences.zh: 这种抗病植物以其整体耐久性给评委留下了深刻印象。

sentences.en: It was bred by Takii Europe B.V.
sentences.zh: 它由Takii Europe B.V.培育。

sentences.en: Dianthus Interspecific Capitán Magnifica is a new dianthus plant.
sentences.zh: 杂种石竹Interspecific Capitán Magnifica是一种新的石竹植物。

sentences.en: It thrived through the test gardens’ summer heat.
sentences.zh: 它在测试花园的夏季高温中茁壮成长。

sentences.en: Its pink flowers, that grow on long stems, can be used as cut flowers.
sentences.zh: 它的粉色花朵生长在长茎上，可以用作切花。

sentences.en: Cutting the plants back after their first bloom can result in strong new growth and better flower production.
sentences.zh: 在第一次开花后修剪植物可以产生强壮的新生长和更好的开花。

sentences.en: This dianthus was bred by Selecta One.
sentences.zh: 这种石竹由Selecta One培育。

sentences.en: Marigold Mango Tango is a marigold that has two-colored blooms: yellow and red.
sentences.zh: 芒果探戈万寿菊是一种有两种颜色花朵的万寿菊：黄色和红色。

sentences.en: The small, strong plants provide nonstop color over an extended season.
sentences.zh: 这些小巧结实的植物在整个季节中持续提供色彩。

sentences.en: The variety was honored by European judges.
sentences.zh: 这个品种获得了欧洲评委的荣誉。

sentences.en: It can be used for plantings in garden borders and in containers.
sentences.zh: 它可以用于花园边界和容器种植。

sentences.en: Ernst Benary of America bred this variety.
sentences.zh: 美国Ernst Benary培育了这一品种。

sentences.en: Nasturtium Baby Gold, Nasturtium Baby Red, and Nasturtium Baby Yellow were also praised by European judges.
sentences.zh: 金宝宝旱金莲、红宝宝旱金莲和黄宝宝旱金莲也获得了欧洲评委的赞誉。

sentences.en: These new, small nasturtiums produce golden-yellow, rich red and soft yellow flowers that look pleasing next to their dark-green leaves.
sentences.zh: 这些新的、小的旱金莲产生金黄、鲜红和柔和黄色的花朵，在深绿色叶子的衬托下显得非常悦目。

sentences.en: The judges praised their uniformly small appearance.
sentences.zh: 评委赞扬它们均匀小巧的外观。

sentences.en: Takii Europe BV bred these flowers.
sentences.zh: Takii Europe BV培育了这些花卉。

sentences.en: Petunia Dekko Maxx Pink is easy to grow and grows quickly.
sentences.zh: 矮牵牛Dekko Maxx Pink易于种植且生长迅速。

sentences.en: These spreading, flat blooms excited the judges during summer trials.
sentences.zh: 这些舒展的扁平花朵在夏季评选中令评委们眼前一亮。

sentences.en: Flowers covered the plants throughout the season and held up well against heavy rain and bad weather.
sentences.zh: 在整个生长季，花朵覆盖整株植物，且能抵御大雨和恶劣天气。

sentences.en: It was bred by Syngenta Flowers.
sentences.zh: 它由先正达花卉公司培育。

sentences.en: Petunia Shake Raspberry F1 has been compared to “a blended raspberry milkshake swirled with lemon-lime green sorbet on a superior-performing petunia.”
sentences.zh: 矮牵牛Shake覆盆子F1曾被比作'一杯搅动着青柠绿雪葩的顶级矮牵牛覆盆子奶昔。'

sentences.en: This flower resisted heat and provided colorful blooms all season.
sentences.zh: 这种花耐热，整个生长季都绽放出绚丽的花朵。

sentences.en: It was bred by Hem Genetics BV.
sentences.zh: 它由Hem Genetics BV培育。

sentences.en: Snapdragon DoubleShot Yellow Red Heart F1 smells like sweet candy.
sentences.zh: 双Shot黄红心F1金鱼草闻起来像甜甜的糖果。

sentences.en: It bloomed earlier than similar varieties in the trials.
sentences.zh: 它在评选中比类似品种更早开花。

sentences.en: Trial judges noted its healthy, strong growth, long-lasting flowers, and good heat tolerance.
sentences.zh: 评委们注意到它生长健壮、花期持久，且耐热性良好。

sentences.en: Hem Genetics also bred this variety.
sentences.zh: Hem Genetics也培育了这一品种。

sentences.en: And finally, Zinnia Zydeco Fire is a disease-resistant zinnia variety that is fiery orange colored with strong stems.
sentences.zh: 最后，Zinnia Zydeco Fire是一种抗病百日菊品种，呈炽热的橙色，茎秆粗壮。

sentences.en: Judges found its flowers to be larger and more resilient than those of similar plants.
sentences.zh: 评委们发现它的花朵比类似植物更大、更有韧性。

sentences.en: Syngenta Flowers bred this variety as well.
sentences.zh: 先正达花卉公司也培育了这一品种。

sentences.en: We hope this list provides you with ideas for your garden planting wherever you are.
sentences.zh: 我们希望这份清单能为各地的你带来花园种植的灵感。

sentences.en: I’m Caty Weaver.
sentences.zh: 我是Caty Weaver。
